This is the default configuration for Tiny Tapeout projects. It should fit most designs.
If you change it, please make sure you understand what you are doing. We are not responsible
if your project fails because of a bad configuration.
!!! DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE unless you know what you are doing !!!
If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
75, not 70: the placement utilisation reached 70.8 % once the last FFT stage saturates instead of halving (+0.9 k um^2 in synthesis)
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
32 MHz = the ADC sample rate; the flow targets it, and the timing margin is checked per corner after the harden
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
Project-specific settings, each chosen by measurement:
PNR_SDC_FILE = LibreLane's base constraints + hold-only clock uncertainty 0.1 ns (constraints.sdc)
Booth-encoded multipliers for the twiddles
N = 16: setup clean at all 9 corners post-layout; strategy chosen by measurement
Clock tree of clkbuf_2/4 under a clkbuf_8 root instead of 71 x clkbuf_16
No delay cells as resizer repeaters, no _0 drivers the resizer cannot repair at ss
Synthesis cell list: the ciel-distributed sky130A PDK used by the GitHub action ships the OpenLane-1
no_synth.cells, which forbids every _1 cell; the PDK this design was signed off with (open_pdks 1689ac3)
does not. Pin the newer list so GitHub and the container synthesise with the same cells.
OpenROAD threads: LibreLane 3.1.0.dev3 runs OpenROAD on one thread when this is unset; 4 = the GitHub runner's vCPUs.
Slew/cap repair on global-route parasitics, 30 % margin
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html
